exposure: mode of delivery (cesarean section vs vaginal delivery)
outcome: frequency of deliveries after 40 years of age
cohort: 142 patients aged 40 years or older who delivered between 2010 and 2012 at the 1st Clinic of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Cluj-Napoca.
finding: Delivery after 40 years of age was associated with an increased rate of cesarean section, particularly in primiparous women.
mod_finding: Eighty percent of nulliparous and 51.72% of multiparous women delivered by cesarean section.
birth_weight: Higher in multiparous than in primiparous women in the cesarean section group
